name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 27, 2014
08:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Anne Scott, a member of the community.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of the "People's Choice Winner" for the Juried Art Exhibit.
P2.
Proclamation declaring Wednesday, June 4, 2014, to be "North County Trade Tech High School Day" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Proclamations recognizing the outgoing Miss Pride of Vista Court and introduction of the incoming Miss Pride of Vista Court.
P4.
Proclamation declaring Thursday, June 5, 2014, to be "Vista High School Band Day" in the City Of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending March 31, 2014 (CC)
C4.
Justice Assistance Grants (JAG) (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving the grant application and authorizing the City Manager to sign related documents; and
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , amending the Operating Program Budget for the FY 2013/14 to recognize 2013 JAG funding.
C5.
Levy of Special Tax for Community Facility Districts (CFD) for Fiscal Year 2014/15 (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , CFD No. 92-1 (North County Square);
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , CFD No. 90-2 (Hacienda Drive and Buena Vista Creek); and
3.
Resolution No. 2014- , CFD No. 2000-1 (Hacienda Gateway Restructuring).
C6.
As-Needed Engineering Surveying Services Agreements (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , with Gold Coast Surveying, Inc.;
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , with Buccola Engineering, Inc.; and
3.
Resolution No. 2014- , with Right-of-Way Engineering Services, Inc.
C7.
First Amendments to Agreements for As-Needed Construction Management and Inspection Services (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , with Valley Construction;
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , with EPC Consultants, Inc.; and
3.
Resolution No. 2014- , with Infrastructure Engineering Corporation.
C8.
Sale of Successor Agency and City Properties (CC/SA)
1.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- , 1315 N. Santa Fe Avenue; (Recommended Action continued on following page)
2.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- , 306 S. Santa Fe Avenue;
3.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- , 114 Natal Way;
4.
Council Resolution No. 2014- , 1335 N. Santa Fe Avenue;
5.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , 603-611 N. Santa Fe Avenue; and
6.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , S. Melrose Drive.
DISCUSSION
D1.
All-Way Stop on Shadowridge Drive at Live Oak Road Update (CC)
D2.
Skate Park Locations (CC)
D3.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Administration (CC)
D4.
Bargain Basement Store Guidelines (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
North County Square Specific Plan Amendment (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing regarding the proposed amendment to the North County Square Specific Plan in order to modify existing signage standards found in the specific plan; and
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2014 -, entitled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Approving an Amendment to North County Square Specific Plan."
PH2.
2014 Regional Transportation Improvement Program Update (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public comment on the City's list of transportation projects eligible to use transportation sales tax (TransNet) funds; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , adopting the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for FY 2015 through 2019.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
